_comment: STATIC WhatsApp Flow for multi-answer (select-all-that-apply) transcript-quiz questions.
_instructions: 1. Registered automatically by `npm run setup:flows` (flow-configs.js → 'Quiz Multi-Select').
2. The resulting Flow ID is written to QUIZ_MULTI_FLOW_ID in your .env.
3. STATIC — no endpoint, no data_api_version. Because one Flow asset serves the whole WABA
and cannot be re-rendered per language, every string the child reads (question, options,
instruction, submit label, the answer token) is supplied per-send as navigate-mode screen
data in flow_action_payload.data, not fetched from an endpoint INIT.
4. Leaving QUIZ_MULTI_FLOW_ID unset falls the question back to the single-select interactive-
list + Done picker — that is the rollback lever.
5. Modelled on training-msq-flow.json's MSQ_QUESTION screen (same CheckboxGroup shape) and on
reading-assessment-flow-v2.json (the only other static Flow in this repo).
_notes: NO min-selected-items and NO max-selected-items, deliberately. Meta renders a helper line under
the label from those two ('Choose 1 to 4 options.') in ENGLISH, generated by the client and not
supplied by us — so on an Urdu quiz it is an untranslatable English sentence sitting under an
Urdu instruction (verified in the live Flow preview, 2026-09-06). Neither constraint bought
anything: `required: true` already blocks an empty submit (the Send button stays disabled), and
a maximum equal to the option count is not a constraint at all. A maximum equal to the number of
CORRECT answers would have been worse than useless — it hands the child the size of the answer
key, which is most of the question.
No RadioButtonsGroup sibling (unlike training-msq): this Flow is only ever sent for a
multi-answer question, so there is no single-answer mode to gate.
quiz_multi_action is a literal string constant ('answer') in the completion payload, so a
completion is identifiable even if Meta drops the answer_token (extension_message_response
has been observed dropped; see bot/shared/utils/flow-type-detector.js).
